thread.title: Somewhat Favorable Press Coverage Extremely Unlikely to Impact Apple (AAPL) Share Price

author: ABMN Staff
title: Somewhat Favorable Press Coverage Extremely Unlikely to Impact Apple (AAPL) Share Price
text:
Another Apple supplier cuts guidance (seekingalpha.com)
AAPL has been the subject of a number of research analyst reports. BMO Capital Markets raised their price target on shares of Apple from $171.00 to $184.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a report on Monday, July 23rd. Macquarie set a $202.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, July 23rd. Morgan Stanley raised their price target on shares of Apple from $214.00 to $232.00 and gave the stock an “overweight” rating in a report on Tuesday, July 24th. Guggenheim reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $225.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, July 24th. Finally, UBS Group reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, July 30th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-two have issued a hold rating and twenty-six have given a buy rating to the company. The stock presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $224.12.
AAPL stock traded up $2.12 during midday trading on Friday, hitting $193.53. 36,186,440 shares of the stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 44,289,096. The firm has a market cap of $951.23 billion, a PE ratio of 16.25, a P/E/G ratio of 1.39 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple has a 1-year low of $150.24 and a 1-year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business earned $2.07 earnings per share. Research analysts predict that Apple will post 13.35 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, November 15th. Investors of record on Monday, November 12th were given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date was Thursday, November 8th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.51%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
In related news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at this link . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, October 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total transaction of $3,235,664.24. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at approximately $24,058,442.48. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders have sold 466,597 shares of company stock worth $104,117,353. 0.08% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
